items.title: Subtitle Placement
items.summary: This subtle adjustment will make subtitles consistently visible and readable, especially in fast-paced conversations where subtle reactive behavior might cause them to be occluded by faces or other dynamic elements.
items.probe: Define one fixed subtitle position rule for V1: keep subtitles at the bottom center of the display.

choices.label: More Prominent
choices.description: Bias toward easier visibility over subtlety.

items.title: Confidence Display
items.summary: This small change will help in building trust by making the confidence display more informative and less opaque. It allows the wearer to understand why a given piece of information is presented with a certain level of certainty, thereby reducing ambiguity and increasing the overall reliability of the system.
items.probe: Choose one confidence display format for V1: label only or label plus short reason.

choices.label: Label Only
choices.description: Keep certainty display minimal and fast to parse.

choices.label: Label + Reason
choices.description: Expose a short reason to improve trust.

items.judgment_reason: aligns with Real-time subtitle clarity, Trustworthy memory support; also addresses under-attended pressure in Discreet UX vs visual clarity, Latency vs richness; meets resistance from Discreet UX vs visual clarity, Latency vs richness; needs counterweight discipline on Latency vs richness, Discreet UX vs visual clarity
items.influence_reason: Repeated pause without new evidence is softly damped.

items.title: Memory/Cache Policy
items.summary: By keeping frequently referenced entities locally cached, the system can provide quicker and more reliable memory support, reducing the need for cloud queries and improving overall interaction flow.
items.probe: Set one local cache eviction rule for face/name memory in V1.

choices.label: Smaller Cache
choices.description: Bias toward tighter local memory and lower load.

choices.label: Recency First
choices.description: Bias toward recent names and conversations.

items.judgment_reason: aligns with Trustworthy memory support; also addresses under-attended pressure in Privacy vs usefulness, Latency vs richness; meets resistance from Privacy vs usefulness, Latency vs richness; needs counterweight discipline on Privacy vs usefulness, Latency vs richness; Code Architecture Specialist can advise on persistent uncertainty without overriding ELI judgment.

items.title: Phone/Cloud Boundary
items.summary: This approach will result in more reliable and timely subtitle delivery during live conversations, enhancing user trust and the overall effectiveness of the smart glasses as a daily assistive tool. It also sets a clear path for optimizing cloud usage where necessary, ensuring that privacy concerns are minimized while still providing rich contextual support.
items.probe: Define one phone/cloud fallback boundary for exactly one task such as live subtitle processing.

choices.label: Phone First
choices.description: Keep critical work local unless clearly necessary.

choices.label: Balanced Fallback
choices.description: Allow cloud assist for slower or richer lookups.

items.judgment_reason: aligns with Real-time subtitle clarity, Trustworthy memory support; also addresses under-attended pressure in Latency vs richness, Privacy vs usefulness; meets resistance from Latency vs richness, Privacy vs usefulness; needs counterweight discipline on Latency vs richness, Privacy vs usefulness; Code Architecture Specialist can advise on design tradeoffs without overriding ELI judgment.
items.influence_reason: Earlier kill is not enforced because new field evidence supports re-emergence.

items.title: Visual Hierarchy
items.summary: By keeping subtitles front and center, we reduce cognitive load during live interactions, ensuring the wearer can focus on what is being said without being distracted by additional text. This enhances overall understanding and trust in the system’s ability to provide clear assistance.
items.probe: Define one visual priority rule between subtitles and one-line support where subtitles dominate display unless the context requires otherwise.

choices.label: Subtitles Dominate
choices.description: Keep subtitles above all other overlays.

choices.label: Balanced Overlay
choices.description: Allow prompts to share attention more evenly.
